{{Lunisolar December}}
'''December 11''' is the 11th day of the month {{ill|Layue|en|Layue|qid=Q905470|lt=December (Shiwasu)}}, the 12th month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}}. Its {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜}} day is {{ill|Butsumetsu|ja|仏滅|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Butsumetsu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10886789}}.
== Events ==
* {{ill|Jianwu|en|Jianwu|qid=Q11065423|lt=Kenmu}} 2nd year ({{ill|Julian calendar|en|Julian calendar|qid=Q11184|lt=Julian calendar}} {{ill|1336|en|1336|qid=Q6028|lt=1336}} {{ill|January 24|en|January 24|qid=Q2278|lt=January 24}}) – {{ill|Battle of Hakone-Takenoshita|ja|箱根・竹ノ下の戦い|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hakone–Takenoshita Battle|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11603356}}. {{ill|Ashikaga Takauji|en|Ashikaga Takauji|qid=Q297107|lt=Ashikaga Takauji}}, who raised a rebellion against the Kenmu Shintō government, defeated {{ill|Nitta Yoshisada|en|Nitta Yoshisada|qid=Q1328796|lt=Nitta Yoshisada}}’s forces. This event marked the beginning of the turmoil of the {{ill|Northern and Southern Courts period (disambiguation)|en|Northern and Southern Courts period (disambiguation)|qid=Q8140349|lt=Nanboku-chō period}}.

== Births ==
* {{ill|Kan'ei|en|Kan'ei|qid=Q1192913|lt=Kan'ei}} 1st year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}} {{ill|1625|en|1625|qid=Q6826|lt=1625}} {{ill|January 19|en|January 19|qid=Q2266|lt=January 19}}) – {{ill|Kitamura Kigin|ja|北村季吟|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kitamura Kikin|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q1743840}}, a {{ill|Waka poet|ja|歌人}} and {{ill|Haiku poet|ja|俳句詩人|qid=DELETED_QID}} (died {{ill|1705|en|1705|qid=Q6830|lt=1705}}).
* {{ill|Kan'ei|en|Kan'ei|qid=Q1192913|lt=Kan'ei}} 3rd year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}} {{ill|1627|en|1627|qid=Q6833|lt=1627}} {{ill|January 28|en|January 28|qid=Q2285|lt=January 28}}) – {{ill|Tokugawa Mitsusada|en|Tokugawa Mitsusada|qid=Q1046230|lt=Tokugawa Mitsusada}}, the 2nd head of the {{ill|Kishū Domain|ja|紀伊藩|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kii Domain|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 紀州藩|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 紀州藩|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q1069187}} and father of {{ill|Tokugawa Yoshimune|en|Tokugawa Yoshimune|qid=Q319664|lt=Tokugawa Yoshimune}} (died {{ill|1705|en|1705|qid=Q6830|lt=1705}}).
* {{ill|Tenpō|en|Tenpō|qid=Q1369045|lt=Tenpō}} 5th year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}} {{ill|1835|en|1835|qid=Q7597|lt=1835}} {{ill|January 9|en|January 9|qid=Q2238|lt=January 9}}) – {{ill|Iwasaki Yatarō|en|Iwasaki Yatarō|qid=Q380105|lt=Iwasaki Yatarō}}, a businessperson and founder of the {{ill|Mitsubishi zaibatsu|ja|三菱財閥|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mitsubishi zaibatsu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10866745}} (died {{ill|1885|en|1885|qid=Q7821|lt=1885}}). <ref>[https://www.britannica.com/biography/Iwasaki-Yataro Iwasaki Yatarō, Encyclopædia Britannica]</ref>
* {{ill|Bunkyū|en|Bunkyū|qid=Q730266|lt=Bunkyū}} 3rd year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}} {{ill|1864|en|1864|qid=Q7704|lt=1864}} {{ill|January 19|en|January 19|qid=Q2266|lt=January 19}}) – {{ill|Sakunosuke Koyama|en|Sakunosuke Koyama|qid=Q11459801|lt=Koyama Sakunosuke}}, a composer and educator (died {{ill|1927|en|1927|qid=Q18110|lt=1927}}).
== Deaths ==
* {{ill|Shōhō|en|Shōhō|qid=Q1146192|lt=Shōhō}} 2nd year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}} {{ill|1646|en|1646|qid=Q6930|lt=1646}} {{ill|January 27|en|January 27|qid=Q2284|lt=January 27}}) – {{ill|Takuan Sōhō|en|Takuan Sōhō|qid=Q632866|lt=Sawakan Sōhō}}, a monk of the {{ill|Rinzai school|en|Rinzai school|qid=Q639625|lt=Rinzai school}} (born {{ill|1573|en|1573|qid=Q6678|lt=1573}}).
